proposed.text: Per PD 1096 Rule XII, Sec. 1207(3), in which direction must the required exit door swing when serving 50 or more occupants?

options.text: Inward, which is generally not recommended for safety reasons in high-occupancy scenarios
Outward, in the direction of exit travel
Either direction, at the occupant's discretion, which is not compliant with safety regulations for large groups
Horizontally sliding, which is not typically allowed for emergency exits due to potential obstructions

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Per Rule XII, Sec. 1207(3), doors serving 50 or more occupants must swing outward in the direction of exit travel. Outward swing uses crowd pressure to help open the door instead of trapping people against it during emergency evacuation.
